items.html: And since Adam HaRishon comprised the three worlds BYA, as mentioned — and the explanation is that from those Hassadim and Gevurot that are in all the Partzufim of the three worlds BYA come out the souls of the lower beings, and all those souls that were included in those Hesed and Gevura of the three worlds BYA were included in the soul of Adam HaRishon — therefore the years of the world had to be as the number of those souls, so that in those years those souls would be formed and come into this world in body and soul and be corrected. Hence the years of the world were six thousand years, corresponding to the number of the aforementioned souls.
